studies.title: Test 2
studies.name: Dwij
studies.notes:
First unattended two-day run (46 h 04 min), on a Raspberry Pi 5 with the ADS1219.
Probe 1 in the flesh of the mushroom, probe 2 in the substrate, probe 3 in the gills, probe 4 in the substrate; the reference in the substrate.
The logger ran the whole time without a gap. The two substrate probes began to climb at about hour 12, and from hour 39 all four probes read the same value. Through the first night, all four probes showed a pattern repeating every 140 seconds, most likely from nearby equipment, although its cause was not established.
studies.data_note: One reading every 5 seconds (the kit recorded one a second; the full file is Test_2.csv in 3_Recording_Tests).

studies.title: Test 1
studies.name: Dwij
studies.notes:
First recording on the Raspberry Pi kit, 2 h 17 min. Four electrodes in the specimen, the reference in the substrate.
The first 40 minutes are the electrodes settling; 97 minutes of steady recording follow.
Recorded on 6 August 2026 — the times inside the file say 8 July because the Pi's clock wasn't set then.
